source.scene: A small attic bedroom at dawn seen from the doorway: low slanted ceiling, an unmade futon on the floor, a round window glowing pale peach as the sun rises over rooftops, a desk lamp still on from the night, a few houseplants, soft cool shadows in the corners.

Top-down view looking straight down at a reading nook on a wooden floor: a patterned rug, a mug of tea, an open sketchbook, a pair of wool socks and a small sleeping dog curled on a cushion, late-afternoon window light falling across in a long rectangle.

A narrow café counter at a rainy dusk, seen from outside through the big front window: one barista in an apron wiping cups, warm interior light, rain streaks on the glass, a bicycle leaning by the door, a striped awning dripping water.

A tiny open-air café table on a hillside terrace in the morning: two cups, a pastry on a plate, a folded newspaper with no readable text, a terracotta wall with climbing bougainvillea, a valley of rooftops falling away below.

Inside a crooked secondhand bookshop: towering shelves leaning inward to form an arch, a rolling ladder, a shopkeeper's cat asleep on a stack of books, a single green-shaded lamp, the aisle leading the eye to a bright doorway at the far end.

The facade of a small corner bookshop at night drawn as a graphic poster: one tall lit window full of book spines as simple coloured blocks, a striped awning, a lamppost, a quiet empty street and a crescent moon.

A small kitchen window counter in early spring: a steaming pot on a two-burner stove, a cutting board with spring onions, jars of pickles, a blue enamel kettle, sheer curtains moving in the breeze, cherry blossoms outside.

A cramped apartment kitchen late at night lit only by the open fridge and a small stove light: a person in a hoodie seen from behind cooking instant noodles, steam rising, city lights through the small window, dishes in the rack.

A steep empty street after midnight seen from the bottom of the slope: a row of narrow houses stepping up the hill, a few warm windows, one vending-machine glow as a plain rectangle, overhead power lines, a big pale moon at the top of the street.

A late-night food stall under an elevated railway: paper lanterns without writing, a cook behind the counter, two stools, steam from a pot, a wet street reflecting the warm light, a passing train above as a blur of lit windows.

Low angle beside a single rural railway line cutting through tall summer grass, the rails running straight toward the horizon, wooden telegraph poles, towering cumulus clouds, a small level-crossing signal, golden late-afternoon light.
A railway viaduct of stone arches crossing a misty river valley at dawn, a small two-car train on top seen from far below, pine trees on the slopes, fishing boat on the river.

A tiny deserted rural station platform at twilight: one wooden bench, a covered shelter with a tin roof, a lone lamp just switching on, an old clock without numbers, rice fields beyond, the first stars appearing.
A snowbound mountain halt at night as a graphic poster: a single platform shelter, deep snow, two parallel rails curving away, one warm lamp, dark pine silhouettes and a sky of large simple stars.

Inside a nearly empty countryside bus in the afternoon: rows of worn seats, one passenger with a straw hat dozing by the window, sunlight flickering through roadside trees, a view of fields and a distant sea.

View from the back seat of a car driving along a coastal highway at blue hour: the rear window frames the road unspooling behind, guardrail, a lighthouse blinking on a headland, the first city lights along the bay.
A small fishing harbour at sunrise: moored wooden boats with nets, gulls, stacked crates, a red-and-white harbour light at the end of a stone pier, mountains behind wrapped in morning cloud.

A container port at night seen from a pier: tall cranes as silhouettes against an orange sky glow, a cargo ship's lit bridge, a lone dock worker with a flashlight, calm black water with long reflections.
A mountain pass road drawn as a graphic poster: a winding hairpin road stacked in zigzags up a steep green slope, one small car, a red guardrail, layered blue mountain ridges and one round sun.
A cyclist pausing at the summit of a high pass in autumn: a hand-painted wooden milestone without text, golden larch trees, a vast cloud sea in the valley below, distant snow peaks.

Deep moss forest after rain: ancient cedar roots covered in thick green moss, a narrow stone path with small stone lanterns, shafts of soft light through the canopy, a small deer standing still in the distance.

A mossy stream in a forest: stepping stones crossing clear water, ferns, a fallen log bridge, a red-capped mushroom cluster in the foreground, a child-sized wooden shrine half hidden by moss, dappled noon light.
A mountain hut in a snowstorm seen from outside at dusk: warm windows, smoke from the chimney, skis leaning against the wall, snow drifting sideways, the peak hidden in cloud.
A lone climber at the foot of a vast snow peak at sunrise, tiny in the frame: pink alpenglow on the summit, blue shadows on the glacier, a line of footprints winding up the slope.
A tropical island cove from a cliff above: turquoise shallows, a crescent of pale sand, leaning palm trees, a small outrigger boat pulled up on the beach, coral shapes visible under the water.
A stilt house over a calm lagoon at sunset: a hammock on the veranda, a wooden ladder into the water, a paddleboard tied to a post, frangipani flowers, reflections in the still water.
A camel caravan crossing tall dunes at dawn seen from far away: long blue shadows, the sun just rising, wind lifting a thin veil of sand from the ridge crests.
A desert oasis at night as a graphic poster: a small pool reflecting a crescent moon, three date palms, a canvas tent with a warm lantern, sweeping dune curves and a dark sky with bold simple stars.
Underwater kelp forest seen from below looking up toward the bright surface: tall kelp ribbons, a sea turtle gliding as a silhouette, schools of small fish as simple shapes, rays of light.
A sunken stone temple stair on the sea floor: weathered pillars covered in coral, a curious small octopus on a step, a manta ray passing far above, soft beams of light from the surface.

A city built on top of a sea of clouds at golden hour: white towers and rooftop gardens on floating terraces, rope bridges between them, a small airship drifting past, a girl on a balcony watering plants in the foreground.
A cloud city as a graphic poster: stacked white and terracotta buildings rising from puffy rounded clouds, little round windows, a cable car crossing a gap, a huge pale sun behind.

A magic library tower interior looking up a spiral staircase: books floating gently between shelves, a reading desk with a candle, a large round stained-glass window with only abstract patterns, a robed librarian on a ladder.
A hidden library inside a giant hollow tree: shelves carved into the living wood, glowing mushroom lamps, a reading armchair, an owl perched on a globe, a doorway opening onto a moonlit forest.

A colossal stone giant statue lying asleep on its side in a meadow, clearly readable as a giant human figure: its huge weathered face with closed eyes in the foreground, one enormous stone hand resting palm-down on the grass, the body stretching away into the distance like a long grassy hill, wildflowers growing in its cracks, a few sheep grazing on its arm, a tiny shepherd with a staff standing beside its face for scale, soft overcast light.
Enormous ancient stone archway standing alone in a shallow sea, half its top collapsed, waves washing through, a small sailboat passing beneath it, seabirds, late-afternoon light.
A night garden under a huge full moon: white moonflowers, a round moon-gate in a garden wall, a stone basin reflecting the moon, a small fox sitting by the gate.
A walled garden on the surface of the moon: neat rows of pale silver plants under a glass dome, the Earth rising blue on the horizon, a small gardener robot with a watering can.
Floating islands as a graphic poster: three rock islands hanging in a pale sky with roots dangling below, a tiny house and windmill on the largest, waterfalls pouring off the edges into nothing.
A floating island seen from a hot-air balloon basket in the foreground: the island's underside of rock and hanging roots, a waterfall falling into cloud, birds circling, morning light.
A ginger cat asleep in a sunny window box among potted herbs, seen from inside the room, lace curtain moving in the breeze, a quiet residential street below, warm late-morning light.
A black-and-white cat sitting on a stack of folded laundry in a laundry basket, looking up at the viewer from below, a sock dangling, a sunlit bathroom tile wall behind.
A family of red foxes at the edge of a birch forest at dusk: two cubs playing, the mother watching, tall grass, the first fireflies drawn as tiny dots, a distant farmhouse light.
A grey heron standing in a reed marsh at dawn, mist on the water, a single dragonfly, lotus leaves, distant hills.
Still life on a linen-covered table: a blue ceramic jug of peonies, a bowl of lemons and figs, a halved pomegranate, a small knife, soft window light from the left, plain warm wall.
Still life as a graphic poster: one tall vase with three stylised tulips, two pears and a sliced orange on a simple tabletop, flat colour shapes, strong shadows as single flat shapes.

An original young courier with short messy hair, a canvas satchel and a yellow raincoat, standing on a stone bridge in the rain, holding a parcel wrapped in paper, umbrella tilted back, canal houses behind.

An original young woman lighthouse keeper with a long braid and a knitted sweater, sitting on the lighthouse gallery railing at dusk with a thermos, wind in her hair, a stormy sea and a ship's lights far away.
A lone astronaut as a graphic poster: a small figure in a white suit standing on a red rocky plain, a huge ringed planet filling the upper-middle sky, two small moons, long simple shadow.
An astronaut floating inside a cosy space station module: a window showing the blue curve of Earth, a potted plant strapped to the wall, a floating mug and a paperback book, warm cabin light.

A student's bedroom at noon in early summer, seen from the foot of the bed: a wide open window with white curtains lifting, a desk stacked with notebooks, a ceiling fan turning slowly, a glass of barley tea sweating on the floor, green treetops outside.

A sleeping loft above a workshop at blue hour in winter: a low bed under a skylight dusted with snow, a hanging string of small warm bulbs, a knitted blanket, a sleeping cat at the pillow, high angle looking down from the ladder.

A tatami room at golden hour in autumn viewed through a sliding paper door left half open: a low table with a teapot, a folded kimono-style robe on a hook, a persimmon on a plate, long orange light stretching across the mats.

A teenager's room during a night thunderstorm, seen from the doorway: a small figure sitting on the bed hugging knees, rain streaking the window, a desk lamp glowing, lightning making the far wall pale blue, posters as blank coloured rectangles.

A tiny studio apartment at dawn in spring, wide shot: a single bed by the window, a bicycle hung on the wall, a kettle on a hot plate, pink cherry branches pressed against the glass, a stack of moving boxes still taped shut.

A reading corner at night close-up: an armchair with a patchwork quilt, a floor lamp with a warm cone of light, an open book face-down on the arm, a cup of cocoa, snow falling past the dark window behind.

A cluttered artist's room in the afternoon, looking from a low angle across the floor: pots of brushes, scattered paper sheets, a half-finished canvas turned away, a sunbeam full of floating dust, a sleeping dog stretched on the planks.

A grandmother's guest room on a foggy morning: a neatly made futon, a small altar-like shelf with a single flower, a hand-stitched cushion, a window showing nothing but soft white fog and the dark outline of a pine, camera at floor level.

A bedroom under a sloped roof at night with the roof window open to the stars: a girl lying on the bed seen from behind, a projector-like nightlight casting dots, a telescope in the corner, summer insects implied by a glowing firefly lamp.

A boy's room after school in the rainy season, seen through the open door from the hallway: a school bag dropped on the floor, a damp umbrella dripping on the mat, a lit desk lamp, a window blurred with rain, grey-green light.

A bright sunroom bedroom at midday in spring: a rattan bed, a hanging fern, a wall of tall windows facing a flowering garden, a small figure stretching by the glass, deep perspective down a line of potted plants.

A small musician's room at dusk: an acoustic guitar on a stand, a keyboard with a folded scarf draped over it, a window showing a purple sky over rooftops, string lights, a cassette-like object with no labels on the shelf, camera slightly above.

A walk-in wardrobe corner of a bedroom in the early morning: rows of coats and dresses in soft colours, a full-length mirror reflecting a pale window, a pair of boots on a rug, motes of dust in a thin shaft of sunlight.

A moving-day empty room at golden hour in autumn: bare wooden floor, a single cardboard box, a rolled-up futon, a potted plant left by the window, maple leaves drifting past the glass, wide low angle toward the glowing window.

A bedroom at night during a power outage: two candles on a dresser, a person with a blanket sitting by the window watching distant dark city blocks, the faint glow of a moon, long soft shadows, calm and cozy, wide composition.

A child's room in the afternoon of a hot summer day: a standing fan turning, a straw mat, a watermelon slice on a plate, a bunch of paper lanterns without writing, cicada-green light, seen from a low angle at the child's height.

A hotel-like attic room by the sea at dawn: a narrow bed, a porthole window filled with a pink sea horizon, a suitcase on a chair, a white gull on the windowsill, a quiet blue palette, camera centred on the circle of light.

A small bedroom in a snowed-in cabin at morning: a wood stove with an iron kettle, a thick wool rug, a window framing a white pine forest, frost ferns on the glass, a person in a sweater wrapped in a blanket seen from behind.

A dim room lit only by an aquarium on a shelf at night: blue ripples of light on the ceiling, a figure asleep under a duvet, a half-open curtain, a quiet city blur beyond, top-down angle on the bed and rippling floor patterns.

A cozy hammock room with a pitched window at dusk in autumn: a hammock slung between beams, a pile of floor cushions, a bowl of tangerines, rain beginning on the roof tiles, a warm lamp, camera low through the doorway.

A dressing-table scene at morning close-up: a round mirror with a wooden frame, a comb, small bottles without labels, a sprig of lavender in a glass, soft light from a lace-curtained window, a hint of a sleeping bed behind.

A writer's room at midnight: a desk under a warm lamp, a mountain of crumpled paper balls, a half-eaten rice ball on a saucer, a cat on a stack of manuscripts without visible text, a dark window with a glowing far-off tower, wide high-angle view.

A bedroom with a floor-to-ceiling window at blue hour in winter: a bed with white sheets, a small figure standing at the glass looking over a snowy city, reflections of small lamps, deep city perspective below, calm sky at the top.

A shared siblings' room at morning in spring: bunk beds, a rainbow of folded clothes, a toy wooden train on the floor, sunlight pouring through a yellow curtain, a puppy trying to climb the ladder, bright and warm, close-up on the floor.

A bedroom in an old house after a summer rain at noon: a screen door opened to a veranda, wind chimes, a bamboo blind half rolled, puddles shining in the garden outside, a folded fan and a glass of water on the tatami.

A tidy craft room at dusk: a sewing machine under a lamp, spools of thread in jars, a dress form wearing a half-finished coat, a window with a plum-coloured sky, a cat curled on a fabric roll, centred composition.

A boy's loft bed seen from below at night: ladder rungs in the foreground, a dangling reading lamp, a rolled sleeping bag, glow-in-the-dark star stickers on the ceiling, a half-open window with moonlight, a sleeping silhouette above.

A sunlit bedroom with a balcony door open at noon in late summer: a sheer curtain billowing, laundry on a drying rack, a bowl of peaches, a distant sea glittering between buildings, a figure sitting on the floor with a fan, wide shot.

A tiny bedroom in a traditional inn at sunset: a low futon, a lacquer tray with a tea set, a paper lantern without writing, a wide window onto a river valley turned orange, a folded yukata-style robe, calm symmetrical view.

A bedroom lit by neon-like colours at night from the street outside: pink and teal light across a messy bed, a headphone set on the pillow, a figure sitting at the desk from behind, a plant silhouette, rain on the window, medium wide.

A messy student room at early morning after an all-nighter: a desk strewn with papers, a blinking lamp, an empty mug, a person asleep on folded arms, first pale sunlight bleaching the curtains, a sparrow on the sill, camera from behind the chair.

A bedroom in a lighthouse keeper's cottage on a windy afternoon: a narrow iron bed, a shuttered window banging softly, a brass telescope, a rope-handled trunk, grey clouds racing in the window, a worn rug, low cosy light.

A laundry-day room in spring: a bed stacked with fresh towels, a basket of clothes, sunlit white sheets drying on a line outside the open window, a small figure folding clothes, floating soap bubble shimmer, camera at bed height.

A study room full of plants at dusk in summer: a wooden desk, hanging ivy, a tall window with fireflies beginning to glow in the garden, a figure leaning on one elbow, an open notebook with no visible writing, soft green gloom.

A bedroom attic window at night during snowfall, extreme close-up of the sill: a candle in a jar, a small potted cactus, a mitten, fat flakes drifting down outside, a dim blue street lamp far below, quiet and still.

A tall narrow room in a tower at golden hour in autumn: a spiral of stairs reaching a small bed under a round window, drying herbs hanging from beams, a patchwork blanket, a view of fields and a winding road, low-angle view up the stairs.

A bedroom in a houseboat at dawn: a low bed, a small round window with water ripples reflected on the ceiling, a hanging lamp swaying, a cup of tea steaming, the misty canal outside, a sleeping cat, gentle blue and gold light.

A teenager's room in a heavy fog in the evening: a bed by the window facing the street, a bike helmet on a hook, headlights floating by in the white, a lit desk lamp, a mug cooling on the sill, calm and drowsy, centred window.

A minimal room with a single mattress and a plant at noon, seen from directly overhead: sharp window light making a bright rectangle on the floor, a shadow of a tree, a folded blanket, a book and a pair of slippers, quiet and airy.

A bedroom decorated for the New Year at morning in winter: a small tabletop decoration of pine and bamboo, a red cushion, paper cranes hanging by the window, a snowy garden outside, a sleeping person under a quilt, calm and festive, wide view.

A small corner café on a spring morning, seen from across a cobbled street: a green awning, tables with chairs tipped against them, a barista sweeping the step, pigeons, cherry petals blowing along the stones, soft pink sky at the top.

A café terrace at golden hour in autumn: round tables under plane trees, steaming cups, a woman reading seen from behind, a bicycle leaning on a lamp post, yellow leaves covering the ground, a wide street perspective with warm light.

Inside a rainy-evening café, looking out through the window: foreground table with a latte and a spoon, raindrops running down the glass, blurry car lights and umbrellas outside, one lone customer on a stool, warm amber interior.

A cat café at midday, wide interior shot: a dozen cats of different colours lounging on shelves, window seats and a cat tree, two customers seen from behind petting one, sunlit wooden floor, potted plants, soft golden dust in the air.

A seaside café at dawn in summer: a blue wooden deck over the water, one table with an iced drink and a half-eaten pastry, gulls on the rail, a pink and turquoise horizon, camera low at table level with the sea beyond.

A close-up of a coffee cup on a saucer at a window table in the afternoon: latte art in the shape of a leaf, a spoon, a sugar cube, a folded napkin, a blurry street with passers-by and bokeh in warm light behind.

A snow-covered café on a mountain road at night: smoke from the chimney, lit windows glowing orange, two skis stuck upright in a snowdrift by the door, soft snowflakes, a dark pine forest behind, wide cold-blue and warm composition.

A greenhouse café in the morning: glass roof dripping with condensation, hanging ferns and orchids, small iron tables, a waiter carrying a tray from behind, a path of tiles leading deep into the foliage, sunbeams slicing through the steam.

A tiny two-seat café built into an old train carriage at dusk: a round window, a bar counter along the wall, mugs hanging from hooks, a sleepy conductor-like barista, the last purple light over a quiet platform outside, symmetrical view.

A rooftop café at blue hour in summer: string lights, a handful of wooden tables, a person leaning on the railing with a drink, city rooftops and distant towers fading to a violet horizon, a quiet and calm top of the frame.

A bakery café at early morning, seen from the kitchen door: trays of croissants and loaves on racks, flour dust in a window beam, a baker's silhouette sliding a tray into an oven, a few early customers in the dim front room.

A café at a bus stop in heavy fog at dawn: a lit window with steamy glass, a lone cup on the sill, the faint outline of a bus shelter in the white, a puddle reflecting the warm glow, tiny figure waiting with a scarf, wide composition.

A garden café in late spring at noon: tables among rose arches, a trellis of wisteria dripping purple, a girl in a straw hat pouring tea, a pie on a cake stand, a white fence, deep green lawn, a high-angle view.

A vintage café at night with a record player: a spinning vinyl with no label on a wooden counter, a leather booth, a dim lamp, a bartender-like barista polishing a cup, a rainy window showing neon-coloured bokeh, close-up and moody.

A mountain lodge café at morning in winter: a big window framing a snowy peak and a ski lift, a mug of hot chocolate with marshmallows in the foreground, a knitted hat on the table, a crackling fireplace behind, wide and bright.

A canal-side café on a misty morning in autumn: tiny boats moored, a waiter setting out chairs, steam from a coffee machine in the window, fallen red leaves floating on the water, a stone bridge fading into the fog, wide vista.

A café courtyard at midday in summer: a fig tree casting dappled shade, a blue-tiled floor, a water bowl for dogs, a sleeping dog under a chair, a half-finished drink with ice, a woman with a book seen from behind, calm top.

A late-night café that stays open, seen across an empty street at midnight: one bright window, a single customer with a laptop-shaped silhouette and no screen visible, a barista dozing, a wet street, a faint moon above the roofs.

A tea-and-dessert café in a traditional wooden house in spring: low tables on tatami, a plate of pink and green sweets, a pot of tea, a sliding door open to a garden of cherry blossoms, a seated figure from behind, low angle at table level.

A café on a ferry deck at sunset: plastic chairs bolted to the deck, a small bar window, a woman with a paper cup watching the horizon, seagulls trailing the wake, copper and pink sky, the sea stretching wide behind.

A cosy bookish café in the afternoon: tall shelves around a few armchairs, a rolling cart of cakes, a steaming pot of tea, a girl asleep with a book on her chest, rain on a round window, low warm lamp light, close-up.

A food-truck café parked at a lakeside in early morning: a hatch window open with steam, a folded awning, two folding chairs, a thermos and a mug on a barrel, mist on the lake and a far-off mountain, tiny sunrise glow.

A café at a train station platform on a winter evening: a lit kiosk with a hot drinks counter, a worker in a scarf passing a cup to a commuter, falling snow in the lamplight, a train arriving as a soft blur, tall perspective down the platform.

A café interior seen from the ceiling at noon: a top-down view of round wooden tables, each with a cup, a plant or a plate, a waiter crossing the room with a tray, the checkered floor, sunlight patches from the windows.

A strawberry parfait and tea on a terrace at golden hour in late spring: the dessert glass in the foreground with a long spoon, soft out-of-focus sea town and sloping roofs below, warm sunlight on a blue-and-white tablecloth.

A café inside a hollowed old tree at dusk: a round wooden door, tiny lanterns without writing, mushroom stools, a squirrel on the counter, fireflies at the entrance, a small figure with an umbrella walking in, mossy forest floor, wide low angle.

A street-corner espresso bar at dawn in autumn: a tiny counter open to the street, a steaming cup being handed to a worker in a coat, a stack of paper cups, a few leaves skidding past, a pale sky and a lit tram stop behind.

A café on a hillside in a rainy season morning: the terrace roof drumming with rain, hydrangeas in wet blue and violet, a cup of tea on a ledge, a distant town in mist, a stray cat sheltering under a chair, seen through a doorway.

A cosy café at midday of a hot summer: shaved ice in a tall glass in the foreground, melting syrup in pink and blue, an electric fan on the counter, wind chimes in the doorway, a bright street outside with heat shimmer, low angle.

A café at night under a bridge with fairy lights: three stools at a counter, a barista with a steaming pot, a train rumbling overhead as light streaks, a wet pavement, a lone figure with a hood sipping, deep blue air, wide framing.

A café garden under snow at dusk: a covered porch with heaters, mugs of cider, scarves on chairs, two people close together seen from behind, soft flakes sparkling in the porch lamp, a pine hedge, a pale violet sky.

A small town square café in the morning of early spring: a chalkboard-like stand with no writing, patrons at metal tables, a fountain, a clock tower silhouette, pigeons, light mist rising from the stones, wide vista with a calm sky.

A café on the first floor of a lighthouse at afternoon: a round room with sea windows, tables with checked cloths, a spiral staircase rising up the middle, a gull at the window, a steaming pot of coffee, bright and breezy, wide shot.

A person alone at a corner window table in a café at blue hour in autumn: coat on the chair, a cup untouched, a leaf stuck to the glass outside, city lights coming on, reflections of the interior on the window, quiet close composition.

A café with a view of a wheat field at noon in summer: an open veranda, wooden benches, glasses of lemonade with mint, a hat on a post, golden wheat rippling in the wind to the horizon, a bold blue sky with a single cloud.

A café's back kitchen door in the evening: a cook sitting on a crate with a cup, a stack of milk bottles, a cat eating a saucer of milk, a bin of citrus peels, a brick wall with a warm window above, string lights and a faint star.

A kids and grandparents café afternoon in winter: a table with hot chocolate, a plate of cookies, a window steamed up with a smiley drawn on the glass, snow swirling outside, a grandfather reading a paper without visible text, warm interior.

A café at the edge of a bamboo forest at dawn: a small wooden hut with a lit lantern without writing, a cup of green tea on a stone, tall green stalks swaying, mist in the aisles of bamboo, a stepping-stone path winding in, a calm sky.

A café on a quiet beach after sunset: a thatched hut with warm lamps, two hammocks, a surfboard leaning on a post, a cold drink with an umbrella on a table, a violet sea with a first star, wet sand reflecting the lights, wide low view.
